hold_open.name: Hold open
hold_open.description: Opens the gate and holds the Remootio output active for a set number of minutes, so gate operators in latch mode stay open instead of auto-closing. The hold can't be released early; it ends when the time runs out. Requires Remootio firmware 2.24 or later.

duration.name: Duration
duration.description: How long to hold the output active, in minutes.

use_trigger.name: Use TRIGGER instead of OPEN
use_trigger.description: Send TRIGGER instead of OPEN. Only needed if no sensor is installed (OPEN requires one). TRIGGER toggles, so it will close a gate that is already open.
